name: @pipeworx/mcp-jsdelivr

tools.name: npm_package_stats
tools.description: Request counts + bandwidth for an npm package served via JSDelivr.

period.description: day | week | month | quarter | year | s-month | s-quarter | s-year (default month)

tools.name: gh_repo_stats
tools.description: Return JSDelivr CDN request count and bandwidth for files served from a GitHub owner/repo for the specified period (day/week/month/quarter/year).

tools.name: top_npm_packages
tools.description: JSDelivr leaderboard of top-served npm packages.

tools.name: list_npm_files
tools.description: jsDelivr Data API — the file tree of one published npm package version (latest by default) as jsDelivr indexes it for CDN delivery. Returns the directory structure with each file's path, byte size, content hash and type, read from jsDelivr's package index. Answers which files, entry points and build outputs an npm package version actually ships.

version.description: Specific published version, e.g. "4.17.21". Omit this argument entirely to get the latest published version — do not pass the literal string "latest"; jsDelivr's API rejects that as an unresolvable version and returns 404.

tools.name: resolve_version
tools.description: Resolve a semver range or tag to a concrete published version.

tools.name: list_npm_versions
tools.description: All published versions for an npm package.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jsdelivr forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jsdelivr pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
